fix: Bearer: sepal with lateral FLOPO:0991380. Quality: increased width towards a sepal with median FLOPO:0991381 (the dorsal sepal), restricted to the basal region ('at base'). Pattern 09 cannot hold it alone, because the target and the bearer are both sepal (rule relation_target_is_not_the_bearer).

fix: Bearer: trichome PO:0000282, part of the fruit. Quality: length 0.1-0.2 mm. 'mealy' and 'greyish brown' are separate records of the hairs. 'hairs' is the bearer, not a quality.

fix: Add the French cues 'à chaque nœud' / 'par nœud' (and 'nœud' to _POSITION_KIND) as per_node. Bearer: flower. Count: 2.

fix: Add a row 'concealing / hiding / obscuring X', read with bearer and target swapped: inflorescence axis PO:0020122 ('rhachis') is concealed by PATO:0002516 towards flower bract PO:0009034. 'completely' stays in RDF as a degree.

fix: Accept 'N-M × as long as' as a ratio cue (ratio 2-5, increased length). Ground 'calycine appendages' (the basal appendages of the Viola sepals) to a FLOPO sepal-appendage anatomy class if one exists; otherwise to the basal region of the sepal.

fix: Split '4- or 5-veined' (suspended hyphen) into a vein count of 4-5, using the existing 'veined → vein' row and the rule '4 or 5' = range 4-5. The container is the lamina (ligule) of the ray floret corolla, not the whole corolla.

fix: '2-lobed' is the quality bilobed PATO:0002214, not a count (see the note on the 'lobed' row of flora_counted_parts.tsv). It is in a union with '2-toothed' (pattern 07), with frequency 'usually' and the region 'at the apex'. Ground the Sorghum numbering of spikelet scales: first/second scale = glumes, third/fourth scale = lower/upper lemma, so 'the fourth scale' = the lemma of the upper floret.

fix: Stamen with inserted into PATO:0000624 towards corolla (pattern 09) in OWL. RDF only: distance PATO:0000040, 3-6.3 mm, measured from the landmark 'corolla base', with the cue 'above the corolla base'.

fix: Bearer: petiole PO:0020038 (a fern stipe; not stalk PO:0025066). Quality: distance PATO:0000040 ≈1 mm towards petiole ('±' = approximate). 'in each row' stays in RDF. OWL: has characteristic some (distance and towards some petiole) with the magnitude. 'number' is the wrong quality.

fix: Make two records, one for root and one for rhizome PO:0004542 (the subjects are coordinated, not alternatives). Quality: length (horizontal spread) with RDF fb:maxAtLeast 4.9 m (source 16 ft, factor 0.3048), cue 'may spread ... or more'. No OWL bound.

fix: Carry the section heading 'Female flower:' as a qualified whole into the clauses after it: stigma PO:0009073, part of a flower with PATO female, is peltate FLOPO:0991107.
reason: This is kind B on a part ('stigma of female flowers'), which pattern 12 covers. The value exists, and stigma is one of its bearers.

target: posterior (sensu botany): of a member of a floral whorl, standing on the side towards the axis of the inflorescence (adaxial); the opposite is anterior
fix: Add posterior and anterior as FLOPO position values beside upper/lower/lateral/median (FLOPO:0991376-0991381). Then: calyx lobe with posterior is lanceolate PATO:0001877 (frequency 'usually'), plus a separate record 'entire' PATO:0104359. The bearer is the calyx lobe, not sepal.
reason: A member of a series named by its position in the flower. upper FLOPO:0991376 means nearer the apex of an axis, which is not the same thing.

fix: When a count comes from an 'N-toothed' word, read 'at apex' as the place of the teeth, not as a count position (do not send the row to count_per_position). Record: corolla lobe/tooth, 5, in the corolla of the disk floret.

fix: Make a one_of with two operands: the continuum purple–black (qualitative_value_relation) and black. Stage 'at maturity' (kind A). OWL: the weaker union has characteristic some (purple or black). The continuum stays in RDF.

fix: Limit the 'or' to the comma-delimited item it stands in. 'gray' is a separate record (PATO gray). The shapes are one_of: ovate-oblong (continuum) or spatulate (approximate, 'broadly'). Bearer: involucral bract PO:0009045 with outer FLOPO:0991379.

fix: Palea is split along its length (split medially PATO:0002169 if the split runs between the keels), with stage 'at maturity' (kind A) and frequency 'usually'.
reason: This is a state reached at maturity, not an event to be modelled. A rule to an existing PATO value is enough.

fix: RDF fb:maxAtLeast 1 m with the cue 'to more than'. No OWL bound. Quality: length, not height, because the stem of a climbing vine is not upright. 'woody' is a separate record.

fix: Height with an inclusive upper bound of the usual range, 0.914 m (source 3 ft), in OWL. RDF: an open maximum extreme with frequency 'rarely' and the cue 'rarely reaches ... more than'.
reason: 'rarely more than X' gives the usual maximum. Pattern 02 holds negated or frequency cues on purpose, and pattern 05 needs numbers in parentheses.

fix: Add the row 'ne se séparant pas de X / not separating from X' → adherent FLOPO:0991188 towards endocarp. This is a positive relation, which avoids a negated relational class.
reason: This is an attachment relation between two layers of the fruit wall, and the value exists.

fix: Map 'N mm thick' to thickness PATO:0000915 (dimension word to attribute), with 'about' as the approximate cue. Bearer: capsule (fruit).

fix: OWL: petal is split PATO:0001786. RDF: the depth of the split, ≈0.5 mm ('±' approximate), as a measurement of the split, with the cue 'split ± 0.5 mm'.

fix: Read '(4 or)5-7' as the usual range 5-7 with a minimum extreme of 4. Read 'pairs' of secondary veins as a count per side of the midvein (pattern 14, each_side), not as a count of all the veins.

fix: Bearer: spore capsule annulus PO:0025093, with a FLOPO value under deciduous, and 'revoluble' as its sibling.

fix: Re-transcribe the statement as one_of (pattern 07, across attributes): subterranean FLOPO:0991035 (approximate: 'not or barely emerging above ground') or length 10-20 cm. Bearer: flowering stem (scape).

fix: Read 'each X contains N Y': count of seed PO:0009010 = 3 in container fruit PO:0009001.
